description:
Activate Orochi Merge-Keeper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Repeat.

uses.name: Orochi Merge-Keeper
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and is modified
